test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The teacher told the students that she had waited for them for about 15 minutes before leaving the class.

options.text: The teacher said to the students, “I could waited for you for about 15 minutes before leaving the class.”
The teacher says, “I had waited for you for about 15 minutes before leaving the class.”
The teacher said to the students, “I waited for you for about 15 minutes before leaving the class.”
The teacher had said, “I had waited for you for about 15 minutes before leaving the class.”

solution:
The correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in** indirect speech.**
 
• The process of changing an indirect speech to direct speech is as follows:
 
 
• Here, **"The teacher"** is the speaker of the reporting speech.
 
• **'told the students'** is the** reporting verb **phrase. In the direct speech, **'told' **changes to **'said to'**.
 
• The sentence part **"she had waited for them for about 15 minutes before leaving the class"** is in the past perfect tense.
 
• In direct speech, it retains** past tense** but becomes more direct, often switching to simple past.
 
• No changes are required in the reference to time ('for about 15 minutes before leaving the class') as it is already suitable for direct speech.
 
• The linker **'that' **will be &
